definition: To accept or admit that something is true or exists.
context_sentence: It is important to acknowledge your mistakes if you want to keep a good relationship with your colleagues.

definition: To get or buy something, or to learn a new skill over time.
context_sentence: It takes many years of practice to acquire a high level of skill in playing the piano.

definition: To publicly support or suggest a particular way of doing something.
context_sentence: Many doctors advocate for a balanced diet and regular exercise to maintain long-term health.

definition: To make something clearer or easier to understand.
context_sentence: Could you please clarify the last point of the contract? I want to make sure I understand everything.

definition: An agreement in an argument in which the people involved all give up something that they wanted.
context_sentence: In a healthy marriage, you sometimes have to reach a compromise instead of always having your own way.

definition: To notice or understand the difference between two things.
context_sentence: It is sometimes difficult to distinguish between high-quality leather and a very good synthetic version.

definition: To remove or get rid of something completely.
context_sentence: The new security system is designed to eliminate the risk of unauthorized access to the building.

definition: To improve the quality, amount, or strength of something.
context_sentence: Adding some fresh herbs can really enhance the flavor of a simple pasta dish.

definition: To judge or calculate the quality, importance, or value of something.
context_sentence: Before buying a used car, you should always have a mechanic evaluate its condition.

definition: To start using a plan or a system.
context_sentence: The company decided to implement a new policy regarding remote work starting next month.

definition: To decide what the intended meaning of something is.
context_sentence: People often interpret silence in different ways; some see it as agreement, others as a lack of interest.

definition: To give or be a good reason for something.
context_sentence: It is hard to justify spending so much money on a designer bag when you have other bills to pay.

definition: To make something as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.
context_sentence: To maximize your productivity, you should try to finish your most difficult tasks early in the morning.

definition: To get something, especially by asking for it or making an effort.
context_sentence: You need to obtain a permit from the local council before you start building an extension on your house.

definition: To say that an event or action will happen in the future.
context_sentence: It is almost impossible to predict exactly how the stock market will behave over the next few months.

definition: To do or begin something, especially something that will take a long time or be difficult.
context_sentence: The university has decided to undertake a major research project on climate change.

definition: Having or expressing more than one possible meaning, which can cause confusion.
context_sentence: His instructions were so ambiguous that nobody knew exactly what they were supposed to do.

definition: Logical and well-organized; easy to understand.
context_sentence: She was so nervous during the presentation that she struggled to give a coherent explanation of her ideas.

definition: Causing a lot of angry public discussion and disagreement.
context_sentence: The decision to build a new highway through the forest was highly controversial among local people.

definition: Extremely important or necessary.
context_sentence: Clear communication is crucial for the success of any team project.

definition: Certain to happen and unable to be avoided or prevented.
context_sentence: If you don't maintain your car properly, mechanical problems are inevitable sooner or later.

definition: Using new methods or ideas to solve problems.
context_sentence: The startup won an award for its innovative approach to reducing plastic waste.

definition: Lasting for a long time or difficult to get rid of; refusing to give up.
context_sentence: If you have a persistent cough for more than three weeks, you should definitely see a doctor.

definition: Having a good understanding of the way people behave and/or a good knowledge of culture and fashion.
context_sentence: The hotel has a very sophisticated atmosphere, making it popular with business travelers.

definition: Able to continue over a period of time; causing little or no damage to the environment.
context_sentence: Many fashion brands are trying to switch to sustainable materials to protect the planet.

definition: One part of a situation, problem, or subject.
context_sentence: The most interesting aspect of the job is the opportunity to travel to different countries.

definition: The situation within which something exists or happens, and that can help explain it.
context_sentence: It is easy to misunderstand a comment if you don't know the context in which it was said.

definition: Something that encourages a person to do something.
context_sentence: The company offers a free gym membership as an incentive for employees to stay healthy.

definition: A result or effect of an action, situation, or event.
context_sentence: We are still waiting for the final outcome of the election; it's very close between the candidates.

definition: Something that exists and can be seen, felt, or experienced, especially something unusual or interesting.
context_sentence: The northern lights are a natural phenomenon that many people travel thousands of miles to see.
